subject.title: [Feature]: Auto‑forward images from Node agent.request to IM users when deliver: true

question: Should `agent.request` grow an explicit, security-reviewed node-to-chat attachment forwarding contract, or should Node callers continue using direct send/message-tool media paths for relay behavior?
rationale: The requested behavior changes the trust and delivery contract between nodes, agents, Gateway, and credentialed IM channels, so automation cannot choose the product/security semantics safely.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in relay
options.body: Define a new protocol/API field with authorization, target scoping, channel capability checks, media limits, audit/logging, and agent override or suppression rules.

options.title: Keep agent-controlled replies
options.body: Leave current behavior unchanged and document that nodes must use direct send/message-tool media or make the agent include media in its reply.

recommendation.title: Add explicit opt-in relay
recommendation.body: Define a new protocol/API field with authorization, target scoping, channel capability checks, media limits, audit/logging, and agent override or suppression rules.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places him on both the gateway node-agent dispatch path and adjacent delivery pipeline work.
